title: Has Cancer Detection from a Blood Sample Really Arrived?
author: 藥時事 Drugnews
summary: Theranos promised multiple clinical tests from a small finger-prick sample. Galleri uses two 10 mL tubes of venous blood. Orders are growing, but the primary late-stage cancer endpoint was not met, leaving “early” in need of more evidence.
cover_image_alt: Dot plot of three FDA advisory committee votes: a majority voted in favor, but the early detection claim remains in question; advisory opinion is not approval.
